subject: Unforeseen fire protection field condition: sprinkler head spacing conflicting with the

messages.text: Sprinkler crew found the sprinkler head spacing conflicting with the ceiling grid layout at Electrical Closet 2A; it's similar to the condition noted in last month's inspection log, but this one isn't shown on Fire Sprinkler Riser Diagram FP-501. This is urgent -- fire protection crews are standing by. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum. This is holding up work in this area. A response within three business days would be appreciated.
Reroute to clear the conflict at Electrical Closet 2A per the attached sketch; proceed once clearance is confirmed. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum.
